newsitem.title: USA: MPTV retains Investor Relations Co.
newsitem.headline: MPTV retains Investor Relations Co.

text.p: MPTV Inc said it retained Northbrook, Ill-based Investor Relations Co as one of several actions being taken by the board subsequent to the placement of new senior mortgage financing on the Lake Tropicana Property which paid off an existing Fannie Mae note.

The new financing includes provisions for the release of condominiums as timeshare intervals are sold. The Company anticipates it will be fully mobilized to begin recording sales and earnings in the first quarter of 1997.
